description: Source code implementing Vulkan shader management classes including ShaderInfo, ShaderLayout, ShaderModule, ShaderLayoutCache, and ShaderCache within the at::native::vulkan::api namespace.

classes.name: ShaderInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a Vulkan shader, including source code, kernel name, layout, tile size, and storage types.

classes.name: ShaderLayout
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan descriptor set layout, created from a signature of descriptor types.

classes.name: ShaderModule
classes.description: Encapsulates a Vulkan shader module created from ShaderInfo.

classes.name: ShaderLayoutCache
classes.description: Caches Vulkan descriptor set layouts for reuse.

classes.name: ShaderCache
classes.description: Caches Vulkan shader modules for reuse.
